About this Event

🪔 THE DIWALI PARTY YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR: BOLLYWOOD BEATS, LIVE DHOL & IMMERSIVE VISUALS! 🪔
Rebel Beatz presents HYPE: Bollywood Visual Rave, Diwali Edition. On Friday, Nov 13, Mirra Bellevue turns into a festival of lights: DJ Kartik and Sync Sultan on the decks, a live dhol player driving the drums, and a full video set lighting up the room on massive LED screen. Throw on your best traditional fit, bring your whole crew, and celebrate Diwali the Rebel Beatz way.
Tickets get more expensive at the door, so lock yours in now.
WHAT TO EXPECT
🎧 DJ Kartik: high-energy Bollywood club & immersive video set, mashups and seamless genre-blending, built to keep the floor packed all night
🎧 Sync Sultan: bringing the first wave of energy to the night
🥁 Live dhol: real drums, live on the night, hitting alongside the beats
📺 Video set: visuals crafted that seamlessly blends with the music, with Mirra's LED walls lit up all night
🪔 Diwali edition: festive glow, festive fits and a dance floor made for celebrating
👗 DRESS CODE - Traditional Indian attire encouraged. Kurtas, sarees, lehengas, sherwanis: bring the Diwali glow. Not required, but the dance floor is going to look incredible.

EVENT DETAILS
📅 Date: Friday, November 13, 2026
🕙 Gates open: 10:30 PM | Event Ends: 1:45 AM
📍 Venue: Mirra Bellevue, Lincoln Square South (3rd Floor), 500 Bellevue Way NE, Suite 310, Bellevue, WA 98004
🎧 Lineup: DJ Kartik (headliner) + Sync Sultan
🥁 Also: Live dhol + Immersive Video set
🔞 Age: 21+
☎️ VIP tables / info: Contact us at - (425) 998-6933
